_comment: Proposed RR CI tasks for the Windows half of Bridgey releases (the CI owner thread adds them to the coordinator, like release-macos and nightly-macos). They run on GitHub's hosted windows-latest runners through .github/workflows/rr-ci-hosted.yml with no secrets: the zips are signed with the release key when scripts/rr/ci-release.sh assembles the release on rr-dev-1, which reads this task's output from RR_CI_INPUT_DIR/<task>. The hosted nightly (.github/workflows/rr-ci-nightly.yml) has its own windows job. See docs/releasing.md, Windows.
